prompt_text: Write a C solution for the HackerRank problem Ticket to Ride.

bug_analysis.bug_description: The solution uses Floyd-Warshall O(n^3) and additional O(n^2 * m) loops, making it infeasible for constraints up to 100000.
bug_analysis.root_cause: Brute-force all-pairs computation instead of leveraging tree structure and LCA optimizations.
bug_analysis.bug_location: Floyd-Warshall and nested loops over u, v, and tickets
